pregunta: cuantas cirugias han entrado a quirofano? es pa la profilaxis
sql:
WITH or_entry_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT surgery_ref
    FROM datascope_gestor_prod.surgery_timestamps
    WHERE surgery_ref IS NOT NULL
      AND regexp_like(upper(coalesce(event_label, '')), 'ENTRADA')
),
surgeries_started AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT surgery_ref
    FROM datascope_gestor_prod.surgery
    WHERE surgery_ref IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date IS NOT NULL
),
surgeries_in_or AS (
    SELECT surgery_ref FROM or_entry_events
    UNION
    SELECT surgery_ref FROM surgeries_started
)
SELECT count(*) AS total_cirugias_quiropano
FROM surgeries_in_or

pregunta: ¿Qué procedimientos se han hecho en hepatología, nefrología y gastroenterología desde finales de agosto de 2024? Necesito el desglose por tipo.
sql:
WITH units_in_scope AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        m.ou_med_ref,
        m.ou_med_descr
    FROM datascope_gestor_prod.movements m
    WHERE m.start_date >= timestamp '2024-08-01 00:00:00'
      AND m.start_date <  timestamp '2026-12-31 00:00:00'
      AND regexp_like(
              lower(m.ou_med_descr),
              'hepatolog|nefrolog|gastroenterolog|digestiu|digestivo|aparell digestiu|aparto digestivo'
          )
),
scoped_procedures AS (
    SELECT
        trim(replace(coalesce(p.descr, p.text, 'Sense descripcio'), chr(10), ' ')) AS procedure_type
    FROM datascope_gestor_prod.procedures p
    JOIN units_in_scope u
      ON u.ou_med_ref = p.ou_med_ref
    WHERE p.start_date >= timestamp '2024-08-21 00:00:00'
      AND p.start_date <  timestamp '2026-12-31 00:00:00'
)
SELECT
    procedure_type,
    count(*) AS num_procedures
FROM scoped_procedures
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 100
